summary: booking and scheduling library: fix twelve reported bugs, move six functions to an options-object API, and add a test file per module. The parts are ordered A to E: B and C rely on the fixes of A, D changes the calls fixed in B and C, and E tests the final code.

parts.title: Core interval, time and rule logic (issues 1-4)
Reports, sorting, state files and CLI (issues 9-12)
Replace positional calls and the global clock with options objects
A test file per module that catches broken implementations
